messages.author: Kenneth Huang
messages.body:
Hi all,
A quick question- for the pucker command in cpptraj, am I correct in
understanding the amplitude for Cremer and Pople's method is in units of
angstroms for nucleic acids?
Likewise, when using Altona and Sundaralingam's method, it would be in
radians?
Best,
Keneth
-- 
Ask yourselves, all of you, what power would hell have if those imprisoned
here could not dream of heaven?

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
Prior to version 4.16.0 amplitudes were in radians. Since then degrees. See
https://github.com/Amber-MD/cpptraj/pull/740
